Location: Abu Dhabi, UAE
Description:

A Marine Engine Department Supervisor is sought for a full-time, onsite role in Abu Dhabi, UAE. The position involves supervising the maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and overhauling of high-speed 4-stroke marine diesel engines, including major overhauls and routine maintenance in workshops and onboard vessels. Candidates require 5-8 years of experience with marine diesel engines, strong supervisory skills, and a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Marine Engineering. Experience with engine manufacturers like Caterpillar, Cummins, MTU, Volvo Penta, MAN, and Yanmar is essential.
